invariants.description: CCSW only writes to data/{car,csc,cae,cfi,rdp,cal,cfe,ccsw}/ and .adaad_agent_state.json; no other paths touched
invariants.enforcement: Fail-closed; unauthorized path access raises RuntimeError before any write

invariants.description: CCSW wire ledger entries form a valid HMAC-SHA-256 chain; broken chain halts processing
invariants.enforcement: verify_chain() validates each record's digest against recomputed canonical payload

invariants.description: CCSW wire ledger is append-only; no record mutation after write
invariants.enforcement: _append_jsonl() opens in append mode; no overwrite path exists in module

invariants.description: No wall-clock injection; all timestamps via _utc_iso(); identical input produces identical subsystem genesis records
invariants.enforcement: All timestamp calls routed through _utc_iso(); no datetime.now() calls outside this function

invariants.description: Repeated bootstrap calls are safe; genesis entries not duplicated; idempotency checked by CCSW_GENESIS source marker
invariants.enforcement: bootstrap_gir_subsystems() checks existing records for source==CCSW_GENESIS before writing

invariants.description: Every wire() call writes a signed ledger entry before returning results
invariants.enforcement: _write_wire_record() called before return in wire(); HMAC-chained entry written first

invariants.description: After wiring, CCA preview score must be >= 0.875; wire() raises RuntimeError if assertion fails — fail-closed
invariants.enforcement: verify_convergence() raises RuntimeError on score < CCSW_MIN_CONVERGENCE_SCORE; wire() propagates

invariants.description: Each wire record sealed with HMAC-SHA-256 over canonical JSON payload
invariants.enforcement: _hmac_digest() applied to _canonical_json() of payload_obj; stored as hmac_digest field

invariants.description: Successful verification (score >= 0.875) emits HUMAN-0 V10 graduation advisory
invariants.enforcement: Advisory written to data/ccsw/human0_advisory_log.jsonl before returning result

invariants.description: Agent state schema_version set to '1.0' only if field is absent; never overwrites existing schema_version
invariants.enforcement: patch_agent_state() checks agent.get('schema_version') before setting; skips if truthy
